glosses: The order or authority to do something, as granted to a politician by the electorate.

examples.text: John Tyler and James K. Polk both regarded the election results as a mandate for the annexation of Texas.

glosses: A period during which a government is in power.

examples.text: Throughout his last mandate, from 1980 to 1984, Mr. Trudeau insisted that we see ourselves solely as Canadians, that we set aside the historic compromises that underlie Canada as a federation.
